title: Simulate forwardRef Pipe
problemStatement: Implement `simulateForwardRef(Component)` that forwards a provided `ref` object as the second argument to `Component(props, ref)`.
interviewTrap: Regular React function components do not accept a `ref` prop; trying to pass `ref` to a normal component warns with 'Function components cannot be given refs'. `forwardRef` is required.

testCases.name: Passes ref object to wrapped component
testCases.testFn: const Comp = simulateForwardRef((props, ref) => ({ type: 'input', refVal: ref.current })); const ref = { current: 'custom-ref-val' }; return Comp({}, ref).refVal;

testCases.name: Passes props along with ref
testCases.testFn: const Comp = simulateForwardRef((props, ref) => ({ name: props.name })); return Comp({ name: 'username' }, {}).name;

testCases.name: Handles null ref gracefully
testCases.testFn: const Comp = simulateForwardRef((props, ref) => (ref ? 'has-ref' : 'no-ref')); return Comp({}, null);

details.name: Passes ref object to wrapped component

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Normally, refs point directly to the underlying DOM node (`<input>`). `useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({ customMethod }))` customizes the ref instance exposed to the parent component, hiding raw DOM methods and exposing only clean, intentional APIs.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Render Phase: Fiber node evaluation and hooks linked-list dispatch for Ref Forwarding Through Higher-Order Components.
2. Reconciliation: Double buffering and fiber diffing mechanics.
3. Commit Phase: Synchronous/passive effect execution and DOM mutation.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals: In React Fiber, Ref Forwarding Through Higher-Order Components maintains state across work-in-progress trees and lanes scheduling priority.

complexity.time: O(1) per hook / O(N) fiber traversal

edgeCasesHandled: Regular React function components do not accept a `ref` prop; trying to pass `ref` to a normal component warns with 'Function components cannot be given refs'. `forwardRef` is required.

specifications: React Fiber Architecture Specification & Runtime Implementation
verifiedRules: Hooks must be called in exact order matching the fiber memoizedState linked list.
